CREATE TABLE api_keys (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(512), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE bots (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	adapter VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	adapter_config JSON NOT NULL, 
	enable BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	use_pipeline_name VARCHAR(255), 
	use_pipeline_uuid VARCHAR(255), 
	pipeline_routing_rules JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	UNIQUE (uuid)
)

CREATE TABLE binary_storages (
	unique_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	owner_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	value BLOB NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (unique_key)
)

CREATE TABLE mcp_servers (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	enable BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	extra_args JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	UNIQUE (uuid)
)

CREATE TABLE metadata (
	"key" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	value VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE model_providers (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	requester VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	base_url VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	api_keys JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	UNIQUE (uuid)
)

CREATE TABLE llm_models (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	provider_uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	abilities JSON NOT NULL, 
	extra_args JSON NOT NULL, 
	prefered_ranking INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	UNIQUE (uuid)
)

CREATE TABLE embedding_models (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	provider_uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	extra_args JSON NOT NULL, 
	prefered_ranking INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	UNIQUE (uuid)
)

CREATE TABLE monitoring_messages (
	id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	bot_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	bot_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	message_content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	level VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	platform VARCHAR(255), 
	user_id VARCHAR(255), 
	user_name VARCHAR(255), 
	runner_name VARCHAR(255), 
	variables TEXT, 
	role VARCHAR(50), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE monitoring_llm_calls (
	id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	model_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	duration INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cost FLOAT, 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	bot_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	bot_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	message_id VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE monitoring_sessions (
	session_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	bot_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	bot_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

	last_activity DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	platform VARCHAR(255), 
	user_id VARCHAR(255), 
	user_name VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id)
)

CREATE TABLE monitoring_errors (
	id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	error_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	bot_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	bot_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	pipeline_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE monitoring_embedding_calls (

	model_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	duration INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	input_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	knowledge_base_id VARCHAR(255), 
	query_text TEXT, 
	session_id VARCHAR(255), 
	message_id VARCHAR(255), 
	call_type VARCHAR(50), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE monitoring_feedback (
	id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	feedback_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	feedback_type INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	feedback_content TEXT, 
	inaccurate_reasons TEXT, 
	bot_id VARCHAR(255), 
	bot_name VARCHAR(255), 
	pipeline_id VARCHAR(255), 
	pipeline_name VARCHAR(255), 
	session_id VARCHAR(255), 
	message_id VARCHAR(255), 
	stream_id VARCHAR(255), 
	user_id VARCHAR(255), 
	platform VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_monitoring_feedback_feedback_id ON monitoring_feedback (feedback_id)

CREATE TABLE legacy_pipelines (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE plugin_settings (
	plugin_author VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	plugin_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	config JSON NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE knowledge_bases (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR, 
	description TEXT,

	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	knowledge_engine_plugin_id VARCHAR, 
	collection_id VARCHAR, 
	creation_settings JSON, 
	retrieval_settings JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	UNIQUE (uuid)
)

CREATE TABLE knowledge_base_files (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

	file_name VARCHAR, 
	extension VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME,

)

CREATE TABLE knowledge_base_chunks (
	uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	file_id VARCHAR(255),

	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	UNIQUE (uuid)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

	space_access_token TEXT, 
	space_refresh_token TEXT, 
	space_access_token_expires_at DATETIME,

)

CREATE TABLE webhooks (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
